subject: ddl: support to set and alter the `AFFINITY` for table (#64988)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent for DDL/infoschema/meta impact: introduces `TableInfo.Affinity` (levels table/partition/none), validates allowed combinations (no temp tables; table-level only non-partition tables; partition-level only partitioned tables), adds `ALTER TABLE ... AFFINITY` job/action, exposes via `SHOW CREATE TABLE` and `information_schema.{tables,partitions}.TIDB_AFFINITY`, and explicitly rejects several partition-management DDLs when affinity is set. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata/state-machine handling, or consistency within the touched scope.
